entities.summary: The Sanctuary of St. Paschal Baylon, commonly referred to as El Sant, is located in Villarreal, in the province of Castellón, Spain. The complex consists of the "International Eucharistic Votive Temple", proclaimed a minor basilica by Pope John Paul II, the Royal Chapel with the tomb of Saint Paschal Baylon, the museum of the Pouet del Sant and the cloistered convent of the Poor Clare Mothers.
